common.questions: If you have any questions we are of course happy to help, and we thank you for your custom.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {site}
welcome.heading: Welcome to {site}
welcome.intro2: your account at {site} has been created. The client area shows your orders, subscriptions, services and invoices in one place.
welcome.outro1: Please complete your address there whenever it suits you — we need it as soon as a contract is concluded or an invoice is issued.
welcome.outro2: This message was sent automatically because an account was created for this address.

orderConfirmed.subject: Order confirmation {number}
orderConfirmed.heading: Your order {number}
orderConfirmed.intro2: thank you for your order of {amount}. We have recorded it under the number {number}.
orderConfirmed.withInvoice: The corresponding invoice {invoiceNumber} is ready in your client area.
orderConfirmed.outro: As soon as your payment reaches us we will set up your services and be in touch again.

invoiceNotice.introOrder: we have issued invoice {number} for {amount} for your order. It is due on {dueAt}.
invoiceNotice.introRenewal: we have issued invoice {number} for {amount} for the next billing period. It is due on {dueAt}.
invoiceNotice.introChange: we have issued invoice {number} for {amount} for your plan change. It is due on {dueAt}.
invoiceNotice.introFee: we have issued invoice {number} for {amount} for the reminder fee. It is due on {dueAt}.
invoiceNotice.autoCharge: We will collect the amount from your stored payment method on that day; there is nothing further for you to do.
invoiceNotice.manualCharge: Please settle the amount by then.
invoiceNotice.attached: The invoice is attached to this message as a PDF.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received for invoice {number}
paymentReceived.heading: Payment received
paymentReceived.settled: we have received your payment of {amount} for invoice {number}. The invoice is now settled.
paymentReceived.partial: we have received your payment of {amount} for invoice {number}. {outstanding} of it is still outstanding.
paymentReceived.topup: we have received your payment of {amount} and credited it to your account balance.

paymentActionRequired.subject: Confirmation required — invoice {number}
paymentActionRequired.heading: Confirmation required
paymentActionRequired.intro2: the collection of {amount} for invoice {number} could not be completed: your bank requires you to confirm it. Until then the invoice stays open, and nothing will be charged twice.
paymentActionRequired.outro: You can find your invoices at any time at {url}.

paymentFailed.subject: Payment failed — invoice {number}
paymentFailed.heading: Payment failed
paymentFailed.intro2: the collection of {amount} for invoice {number} did not succeed. Nothing was charged, and the invoice remains open.
paymentFailed.reason: Reason given by the payment provider: {reason}
paymentFailed.advice: Please check your stored payment method or settle the invoice another way. We will try the collection again over the coming days.

dunning.feeNotice: We charge a fee of {fee} for the reminder; it will be invoiced separately.

reminder.subject: Payment reminder for {number}
reminder.line1: Invoice {number} for {amount} was due on {day} and has not yet reached us.
reminder.line2: If this has crossed with your payment, please disregard this message.

mahnung.subject: Reminder for {number}
mahnung.line1: Invoice {number} for {amount} was due on {day} and is still outstanding.
mahnung.line2: Please settle the amount. Otherwise we will have to suspend the services temporarily.

suspend.subject: Services suspended — {number}
suspend.line1: Invoice {number} for {amount} has been outstanding since {day}; the associated services are now suspended.
suspend.line2: They will be unblocked automatically as soon as the payment arrives.

terminate.subject: Subscription ended — {number}
terminate.line1: Invoice {number} for {amount} has been outstanding since {day}. The associated subscription has therefore ended and the services are being torn down.

trialEnding.subject: Your trial ends on {day}
trialEnding.heading: Your trial is ending
trialEnding.intro1: The free trial for “{label}” ends on {day}.
trialEnding.intro2: After that {amount} will be charged per period. If you do not wish to continue, please cancel in the client area before then.

serviceActivated.subject: {label} is ready
serviceActivated.heading: Your service is ready
serviceActivated.intro2: “{label}” has been set up and is running. The client area holds the credentials, the IP addresses and the console.
serviceActivated.outro: For security reasons the password is not included in this message; you can view it in the client area.

serviceSuspended.subject: {label} has been suspended
serviceSuspended.heading: Your service has been suspended
serviceSuspended.introDunning: “{label}” has been suspended because an invoice for it has been outstanding for some time. As soon as the payment reaches us we will unblock the service automatically.
serviceSuspended.introSubscription: “{label}” has been suspended because the associated subscription is paused. It will run again as soon as the subscription is resumed.
serviceSuspended.outro: Your data is retained while the service is suspended.

serviceTerminated.subject: {label} has been torn down
serviceTerminated.heading: Your service has been torn down
serviceTerminated.introDunning: “{label}” has been torn down because the outstanding invoice was not settled despite a reminder.
serviceTerminated.introSubscription: “{label}” has been torn down because the associated subscription has ended.
serviceTerminated.outro: The data on this service has been deleted and cannot be restored.

subscriptionEnded.subject: Subscription ended — {label}
subscriptionEnded.heading: Your subscription has ended
subscriptionEnded.intro2: the subscription “{label}” ended on {day}. Nothing further will be charged.
subscriptionEnded.outro: Your invoices and receipts remain available in the client area.

ticketReplied.subject: Reply to ticket #{number}: {subject}
ticketReplied.heading: Reply to ticket #{number}
ticketReplied.intro2: there is a reply to your request “{subject}”. You can read it in the client area and reply there directly.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.addressMissing: Your address is not complete yet. We need it as soon as a contract is concluded or an invoice is issued.
dashboard.subscriptionsActive: {count, plural, =0 {None active} one {# active} other {# active}}
dashboard.subscriptionsHint: {count, plural, =0 {No subscriptions yet} one {# in total} other {# in total}}
dashboard.servicesActive: {count, plural, =0 {None active} one {# active} other {# active}}
dashboard.servicesHint: {count, plural, =0 {No services yet} one {# in total} other {# in total}}
dashboard.invoicesOpen: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing open} one {# open} other {# open}}
dashboard.ticketsOpen: {count, plural, =0 {None open} one {# open} other {# open}}
dashboard.overdue: Invoice {number} for {amount} has been due since {day}.
dashboard.actionRequired: Your bank requires confirmation for invoice {number}.

privacy.title: My data
privacy.intro: Under Art. 15 and Art. 20 GDPR you can request a copy of all the data we hold about your account. The archive contains a machine-readable JSON file and every document as a PDF.
privacy.note: The export is produced as you download it and reflects the current state. Every export is logged.
privacy.deletionIntro: Invoices and receipts are subject to the statutory retention period and cannot be deleted while it runs. For deletion of your remaining data please contact support — we will then anonymise your account as soon as there are no outstanding items and no running services.
